source: Strategy rules from quants.md (QuantJourney, Apache-2.0), rebuilt for crypto and tested on Binance daily data

strategies.name: Hold the 10-coin basket
strategies.rules: Equal weights, rebalanced when a coin drifts 15+ points from its share (benchmark)

strategies.name: SMA 50/200 trend
strategies.rules: Hold BTC while its 50-day average is above its 200-day average, else cash

strategies.name: SMA 20/50 cross
strategies.rules: Hold BTC while its 20-day average is above its 50-day average, else cash

strategies.name: MACD trend
strategies.rules: Hold BTC while MACD is above its signal line, else cash

strategies.name: RSI reversion
strategies.rules: Buy BTC when RSI(14) falls under 35, sell when it rises over 60

strategies.name: Bollinger reversion
strategies.rules: Buy BTC on a close under the lower band (20, 2), sell back at the middle band

strategies.name: Defensive switch
strategies.rules: Hold the basket while BTC is above its 200-day average, else cash

strategies.name: Dual momentum
strategies.rules: Each month, hold the 3 coins with the best 90-day return, only if positive; else cash

strategies.name: Inverse volatility
strategies.rules: Each month, weight the basket by 1 / 63-day volatility

strategies.name: Risk parity, capped
strategies.rules: Inverse-volatility weights with a 25% cap per coin, monthly

strategies.name: Volatility-targeted trend
strategies.rules: Coins above their 100-day average, scaled to 40% yearly volatility

strategies.name: Volatility-targeted momentum
strategies.rules: Monthly top-3 momentum, scaled daily to 50% yearly volatility
